content.text: In Zimbabwe, Nigeria, and other nations where Stripe and PayPal are restricted, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-what-actually|How Creators]] struggle to sell ebooks, courses, and templates. These platforms' 10% fees are a significant burden, leaving creators with mere pennies on each sale. To avoid this, savvy entrepreneurs build their own infrastructure, leveraging NOWPayments' 0.5% fee and cloud-based tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Supabase. In this guide, we'll walk you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-complete-infrastructure-4|setting]] up a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-2|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] digital commerce stack that lets you sell your digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-5. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

This infrastructure works because it's built on decentralized, cloud-based tools that aren't bound by geographical restrictions. By using NOWPayments, you can accept cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT, which aren't limited by borders. Moreover, you can store your customer data and order information in Supabase, a cloud-based database that's accessible from anywhere. This setup allows you to sell your digital products globally, without relying on platforms that might restrict access.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to acquire the necessary tools and knowledge. First, get the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to build, deploy, and scale your stack. Next, familiarize yourself with the tools you'll be using, such as GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Finally, set up your payment and delivery pipeline by integrating NOWPayments with your chosen delivery method, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your chosen delivery method. Start by setting up a NOWPayments account and obtaining your API keys. Then, create a new Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script that will handle payment verification and delivery. Use the NOWPayments API to verify payments and trigger delivery. Finally, test your pipeline by making a payment and verifying that the delivery works as expected.
By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can accept cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum, and store customer data efficiently.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live. Deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack to a cloud-based platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure your payment method and delivery settings. Finally, test your stack by making a payment and verifying that the delivery works as expected. When everything is working smoothly, it's time to launch your digital product and start processing transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.

The most common question we receive is: 'Can I sell digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal?' The answer is yes. With the right infrastructure, you can sell your digital products globally, without relying on platforms that might restrict access. By following this guide, you can set up your own infrastructure and start selling your digital products without relying on platforms.

Your Deployment Checklist

To set up your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Create a NOWPayments account and obtain your API keys. Set up a new Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script that will handle payment verification and delivery. Integrate NOWPayments with your chosen delivery method. Deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack to a cloud-based platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Configure your payment method and delivery settings. Test your stack by making a payment and verifying that the delivery works as expected. Monitor your system's performance and identify bottlenecks. Optimize your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script code to improve performance. Consider adding more instances or upgrading your storage to ensure that your system can handle the increased load.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a sovereign digital commerce stack?

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a setup of decentralized, cloud-based tools that allow you to accept cryptocurrencies and store customer data efficiently. This setup includes tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments.

To integrate NOWPayments with your chosen delivery method, start by setting up a NOWPayments account and obtaining your API keys. Then, create a new Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script that will handle payment verification and delivery. Use the NOWPayments API to verify payments and trigger delivery.
Can I use a different delivery method than Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script?

Yes, you can use a different delivery method than Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. For example, you can use a custom script or a third-party delivery service. However, make sure that your chosen delivery method is compatible with NOWPayments and your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I optimize performance with Supabase and Cloudflare?

To optimize performance with Supabase and Cloudflare, start by setting up Supabase and integrating it with your Cloudflare Pages deployment. Then, configure Cloudflare to cache static assets and reduce latency. Finally, monitor your system's performance and identify bottlenecks to optimize your setup.
